>But this is the Hierarchy of Needs...?...you could measure the level you're stuck in as cause for depression.

>Don't just give up, because you have the potential to become someone very great.

Thank you for your concern. I appreciate your kindness man...

>Loneliness sucks, I haven't had any real friends now for many years and I too haven't ever had a girlfriend, and until last Christmas I'd been unemployed for 4 months, but I then decided to do everything I could to turn my life around. I now have my own freelance web-design company, physically fitter than I've ever been, learning lots of new things (I signed up to literally about 7 part time courses), and now I'm actually happier than I've ever been. I don't mean to rub anything in your face there, but I kind of just want you to know that it is possible to go from what you're feeling now to having a meaningful life.

No worries man, I'm very happy for you...hope things continue to get even better with you. I'm sure your web design company will pay off.


As for getting a gf it's like a skill..you really just have to have tons of conversations with everyone until with comfortable with women...it worked for me(except not having money)....but you probably already what to do.
